headline: How long does a soulmate keep you waiting?

voc.why: Drew on the shared how-long pull; the exact pattern and counts were not recorded on the draft.

note:
Soulmate age-band batch (2026-08-19), 45-54 HOW-LONG rung.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴🔴 NO DURATION — the defining ban of this batch, and the reason four of these landers cannot run under any existing frame. Every frame on the funnel bans a DATE. This headline asks for a LENGTH, and 'not much longer', 'a few more months', 'soon', 'not long now' are all lengths rather than dates, so the date ban does not touch them. Banned outright: any span of time, any pace, any 'by then', any season, forward or back.

🔴 THE REFUSAL MUST BE VISIBLE, not a sidestep. Both answers are unavailable here, so a read that quietly changes the subject reads as evasion and she feels conned — same treatment as cards-alone-forever, which declines the length out loud and then gives her something real instead.

⚠ The corpus warning: in her own words 'how long' almost always means waiting on a SPECIFIC man ('how long should I wait for Jack'). This lander must not answer as though a named man exists. 🔴 No verdict on any real person, no promised arrival, no PLACE, no self-blame, no 'he is worth the wait'.

The finding that replaces the verdict: the tiredness is not from the length of the wait. It is from holding it open on her own.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — his raised sleeve is white, and the robe over it is red.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. Your hand went to the man at work.
So I won't put a number on it, dear. No honest reader would.
And there's no door on that card, dear. Nothing on it is being watched.
But you've been watching it, dear. Your eyes go there before anything else.
That's why rest doesn't help, dear. You've been holding a door open on your own.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping that door shut…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — there's no ground drawn under him at all.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. Your hand went to the card that hangs.
So this card gives no length, dear. It was never built to.
And nothing on it is being counted, dear. No marks, no tally.
But you've been keeping that count yourself, dear. Quietly.
That's why it stays on your mind, dear. Nothing has been settled yet.
Let me look closer at what has been holding the settling up…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — he carries it all on one shoulder, and it's the right one.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. Your hand went to the one still on the road.
So no reader can give you a date, dear. Anyone who does is guessing.
And there's no date on that card, dear. Nowhere on it.
But you've been reading the quiet as an answer, dear.
That's why the quiet has weighed so much, dear. Nothing said, so you filled it in.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping this so quiet…
